theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_product_support_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R₀ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)), Module.finrank ℝ L < n → R.Represents S → R₀.Represents S₀ → R₀.measure (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∫⁻ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), R₀.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]) → (∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, ∃ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity S₀ y θ) → (∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, (t + y ∈ S.support ↔ y ∈ S₀.support)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, ∀ θ : ℝ, (HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ↔ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ)
